editorial:
Ever feel like you just cannot make up your mind? Meet Vansan, a guy who is so bad at making choices that even picking shoe colors feels like a huge crisis. He is basically the king of hesitation. You will find his struggle funny at first, but then things get wild. After a crazy car accident, he suddenly wakes up sixteen years in the future. Instead of the simple life he imagined, he is now a big boss at a company, married to a stranger, and dealing with kids who do not even like him. It is a total nightmare because he has become the exact type of boring, corporate person he used to hate.

The acting is great because you can really feel his panic as he tries to figure out his new life. The pacing keeps you interested, and the comedy hits just right when he tries to bond with his family. One downside is that some parts feel a bit slow, but the emotional payoff makes up for it. If you want a lighthearted story about second chances, you should definitely check this out. You can grab the 4K Blu-ray to keep in your physical collection for the best picture quality, or just rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night with friends.
endingExplained: Vansan eventually learns that being a success in business does not mean he is happy. After struggling to connect with his kids and wife, he finds a way to trigger the time jump again. He wakes up back in his original time, right before the accident. Instead of freezing up, he finally makes a firm decision about his life and love. He chooses to be honest and bold, ensuring he builds a future based on true happiness rather than money.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves stories about fate and fixing past mistakes.
